questions.questionText: PFAs are long-lasting, difficult-to-breakdown substances used in everything from fire retardants and non-stick pan coatings to pizza boxes and cosmetics, and often known as ‘forever chemicals’, as they ---- in the environment for a long time.
questions.explanation: Cümlede 'sonsuz kimyasallar' (forever chemicals) olarak bilinen PFA'ların doğada uzun süre 'dayandığı/kaldığı' ifade edilmektedir. Bu nedenle boşluğa 'dayanmak, varlığını sürdürmek' anlamına gelen 'endure' kelimesi gelmelidir. Diğer seçenekler (accelerate: hızlandırmak, assemble: bir araya getirmek, recede: geri çekilmek, elaborate: detaylandırmak) bağlama uymamaktadır.
options: A) accelerate
B) assemble
C) endure
D) recede
E) elaborate

questions.questionText: ---- ground-breaking discoveries in scientific papers are curated to be succinct and organised, the journey to get there is full of surprises, failures, and perseverance with which every scientist can connect.
questions.explanation: Cümlede bilimsel makalelerdeki çığır açan keşiflerin kısa ve düzenli olması ile bu noktaya gelene kadar yaşanan sürecin sürprizler ve başarısızlıklarla dolu olması arasında bir zıtlık kurulmaktadır. 'Even though' (rağmen / -sa bile) bağlacı bu zıtlığı anlamsal olarak kusursuz bir şekilde sağlar.
options: A) As if
B) Since
C) In case
D) Even though
E) As long as

questions.questionText: Herbs and spices add only a negligible number of calories to the foods to which they are added; ----.
questions.correctAnswer: A) as a result, they are an excellent replacement for both fat and salt when it comes to flavouring food
questions.explanation: İlk cümlede otların ve baharatların yiyeceklere sadece ihmal edilebilir (çok az) miktarda kalori kattığı söyleniyor. Noktalı virgülden sonra bu olumlu özelliğin doğal bir sonucu veya faydası gelmelidir. A seçeneği 'sonuç olarak (as a result), yemekleri tatlandırmak söz konusu olduğunda hem yağ hem de tuz için mükemmel bir alternatiftirler' diyerek anlam bütünlüğünü ve sebep-sonuç ilişkisini tam olarak kurar.
options: A) as a result, they are an excellent replacement for both fat and salt when it comes to flavouring food
B) therefore, using natural products containing them in place of traditional medicines may have harmful effects
C) in other words, both still play a diminished role in shaping cuisine and adding interest to foods
D) on the contrary, fresh herbs are highly perishable and may last only a few days in the refrigerator
E) still, some of the earliest medical manuscripts highlight the theoretical healing properties of these flavourings

questions.questionText: 18. ve 19. yüzyıl Osmanlı askerî ıslahatları Fransız uzmanlardan etkilendiği için bu uzmanların kitapları, Fransızcanın yabancı dil olarak öğretildiği yeni kurulan askerî okulların müfredatının bir parçası olmuştur.
questions.correctAnswer: B) Since the Ottoman military reforms of the 18th and 19th centuries were influenced by French experts, these experts’ books became a part of the curriculum of the newly established military schools, where French was taught as a foreign language.
questions.explanation: Türkçe cümlenin 'etkilendiği için' kısmı 'Since ... were influenced by' yapısı ile tam olarak B seçeneğinde verilmiştir. 'bu uzmanların kitapları ... müfredatının bir parçası olmuştur' ana cümlesi 'these experts’ books became a part of the curriculum' ile çevrilmiş, 'Fransızcanın yabancı dil olarak öğretildiği' kısmı ise sıfat cümleciği kurallarına uygun biçimde 'where French was taught as a foreign language' şeklinde doğru ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) After the influence of French experts on the Ottoman military reforms of the 18th and 19th centuries, these experts’ books became a part of the curriculum of the newly established military schools, where French was taught as a foreign language.

B) Since the Ottoman military reforms of the 18th and 19th centuries were influenced by French experts, these experts’ books became a part of the curriculum of the newly established military schools, where French was taught as a foreign language.

C) French experts influenced the Ottoman military reforms of the 18th and 19th centuries; as a result, these experts’ books became a part of the curriculum of the newly established military schools and French was taught as a foreign language.

D) Because the Ottoman military reforms of the 18th and 19th centuries were influenced by French experts, French was taught as a foreign language at the newly established military schools, where these experts’ books were a part of the curriculum.

E) The Ottoman military reforms of the 18th and 19th centuries were influenced by French experts; as a result, these experts’ books were taught at the newly established military schools, making French a part of the curriculum as a foreign language.

questions.questionText:
Seth: Nowadays there’s a lot of hype about the four-day work week. As an employee I love the idea, but from the employer’s perspective I guess it wouldn’t be a popular one.
Leila:
 I disagree. I've read a recent study on this topic. It revealed that a four-day work week benefits both the employee and employer in a few ways.
Seth:
 How so?
Leila:
 ----
Seth:
 Based on that, it is safe to say that four-day work week is a win-win situation.
questions.correctAnswer: C) Interestingly, it lowered burnout, raised productivity and revenue, and led to improvements in job satisfaction as well as physical and mental well-being.
questions.explanation: Diyalogda Leila dört günlük çalışma haftasının hem işverene hem çalışana fayda sağladığını söylüyor. Seth 'Nasıl yani?' (How so?) diye sorduğunda, Leila'nın boşlukta bu faydaları listelemesi gerekir. C seçeneğinde 'İlginç bir şekilde, tükenmişliği azalttı, üretkenliği ve geliri artırdı ve iş memnuniyetinin yanı sıra fiziksel ve zihinsel refahta iyileşmelere yol açtı' denilerek tam olarak Seth'in 'kazan-kazan durumu' (win-win situation) sonucuna varmasını sağlayacak iki taraflı faydalar sıralanmaktadır.
options: A) Well, low value meetings became phone calls and messages, while employees used the extra day off to take care of personal matters like running errands or simply relaxing.
B) You know, a four-day work week is becoming a more popular trend around the globe because companies see that it’s actually good for business.
C) Interestingly, it lowered burnout, raised productivity and revenue, and led to improvements in job satisfaction as well as physical and mental well-being.
D) I mean, employers are more likely to allow a four-day work week if they see that it’s mutually advantageous.
E) Actually, it might break down the communication between colleagues as their schedules might not overlap.

questions.questionText: The Maya, who took control of much of Mesoamerica after the demise of the Olmecs, were the most sophisticated and powerful of the civilisations in the Americas before the arrival of Europeans.
questions.correctAnswer: B) Until Europeans arrived in the Americas, the Maya had been the most advanced and influential civilisation in the region, who ruled Mesoamerica to a great extent following the fall of the OImecs.
questions.explanation: Cümlede 'Avrupalıların gelişinden önce en gelişmiş ve güçlü medeniyetti' ifadesi 'Until Europeans arrived..., the Maya had been the most advanced and influential civilisation' şeklinde tam olarak karşılanmaktadır. 'Olmec'lerin çöküşünden sonra Mesoamerica'nın çoğunu kontrol eden' yan cümlesi ise 'who ruled Mesoamerica to a great extent following the fall of the Olmecs' şeklinde, anlam kaybı yaşatmadan doğru biçimde yeniden ifade edilmiştir (rephrasing).
options: A) What made the Maya civilisation the most advanced and influential civilisation in the Americas is that they ruled the lands of the Olmecs after their fall; however, their supremacy lasted only till Europeans arrived in Mesoamerica.
B) Until Europeans arrived in the Americas, the Maya had been the most advanced and influential civilisation in the region, who ruled Mesoamerica to a great extent following the fall of the OImecs.

C) Achieving superiority in Mesoamerica after bringing an end to the Olmecs, the Maya had been the dominant power and most advanced civilisation in the region till the Europeans’ arrival in the Americas.

D) After Europeans appeared in the Americas, which coincided with the fall of the Olmecs, the Maya, who had been the central power in much of Mesoamerica, lost their power of being the most advanced and influential civilisation in the region.

E) Before the arrival of Europeans and the collapse of the Olmecs, it was the Maya that ruled a substantial part of Mesoamerica and became the most advanced and influential civilisation in the region.

questions.questionText: Chatbots are not the only artificial intelligence (AI) models to have advanced in recent years as there are many specialised models trained on biological data which could help accelerate vaccine development and cure diseases. However, the same qualities that make these models beneficial introduce potential dangers as well. ---- That is why experts are calling for governments to introduce mandatory oversight and guardrails for advanced biological models. While today’s AI models probably do not substantially contribute to biological risk, future models could help to engineer new pandemic capable pathogens, which is why a structured government oversight is necessary so that the risks of especially powerful biological weapons in the future is minimised.
questions.correctAnswer: C) For an AI model to be able to design a vaccine that is safe for humans, for instance, it must first know what is harmful for them.
questions.explanation: Boşluktan önceki cümlede yapay zeka modellerinin 'faydalı kılan özelliklerinin potansiyel tehlikeler de barındırdığı' ifade ediliyor. Boşluktan sonra ise uzmanların tam da bu yüzden hükûmet denetimi çağrısında bulunduğu söyleniyor. C seçeneğinde 'Örneğin, bir yapay zekanın insanlar için güvenli bir aşı tasarlayabilmesi için, öncelikle neyin zararlı olduğunu bilmesi gerekir' denilerek, sistemin hem şifa hem de zarar verme potansiyeline sahip olduğu örneklendirilmekte ve iki cümle arasındaki mantıksal köprü eksiksiz kurulmaktadır.
options: A) Harmful pathogens that have been weaponised can spread among humans but their lethality decreases in time.
B) It is nearly impossible for an AI model to be hostile towards human beings unless it was conditioned to be.
C) For an AI model to be able to design a vaccine that is safe for humans, for instance, it must first know what is harmful for them.
D) If future AIs are capable of doing research autonomously, this could lead to incredible breakthroughs in drug design and discovery.
E) Experts are worried that strict governmental regulation could hinder the development of biological AI models.

questions.questionText: (I) The northern lights, or aurora borealis, are generated by the solar wind – a stream of charged particles travelling from the outer layer of the sun. (II) Bursts of solar wind, called solar flares, slam into Earth’s magnetic field, which acts like a shield around the planet that deflects most of the particles. (III) The particles take around a day to travel to Earth, so how strong the aurora is likely to be can be predicted up to a day in advance. (IV) But at its weakest points around the poles, some particles penetrate into the upper atmosphere, where they collide with and excite, or energise, gas molecules. (V) As these molecules lose energy again, they release photons of light that make the auroras.
questions.explanation: Parçada kuzey ışıklarının (aurora borealis) nasıl oluştuğu adım adım bilimsel bir fiziksel süreçle (güneş rüzgarı, manyetik alana çarpma, atmosfere sızma, moleküllerle çarpışma ve ışık/foton salınımı) anlatılmaktadır. Ancak III. cümlede parçacıkların dünyaya geliş süresi ve auroranın gücünün önceden tahmin edilebilmesi gibi 'insan tahmini/zamanlama' konusuna girilerek, I-II-IV-V cümleleri ile sağlanan ardışık fiziksel oluşum (parçacıkların hareketi) akışı sekteye uğratılmıştır. Bu nedenle anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle III numaralı cümledir.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
